# eval

Metrics, costs and statistical checks.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| [calibrate_impact.py](calibrate_impact.py) | Calibrate ``ImpactCostModel`` from real execution records (the one input this project cannot fabricate). |
| [costs.py](costs.py) | Cost-aware backtest (Blueprint §3.9): turnover-proportional blended cost+slippage with a 1x/2x/5x stress table. |
| [dataset.py](dataset.py) | Fast labelled point-in-time dataset: join labels onto the serving feature store (already membership-filtered, unlabelled) instead of rebuilding ~100 features from bars -- seconds instead of ~10 minutes. |
| [longshort.py](longshort.py) | Market-neutral cross-sectional long/short test (the quantity a daily cross-sectional IC suggests): on each rebalance date go long the top-q and short the bottom-q names by score (each leg 50% of capital), hold ``hold`` days, charge the impact-cost model on every weight change. |
| [metrics.py](metrics.py) | Evaluation metrics (Blueprint §3.1): accuracy, balanced accuracy, log loss, Brier, ROC-AUC, and the Spearman Information Coefficient (implemented on ranks -- no scipy.stats dependency). |
| [spread_estimators.py](spread_estimators.py) | Bid-ask spread estimated from public daily OHLC (Corwin & Schultz 2012; Abdi & Ranaldo 2017) - the only spread evidence available without tick data. |
| [stat_rigor.py](stat_rigor.py) | Selection-aware statistics for a Sharpe ratio that was picked after many looks and has autocorrelated (overlapping-hold) returns. - ``effective_n``: T / (1 + 2 sum rho_k) (Bartlett weights) - the number of independent days. - ``deflated_sharpe``: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) probability that the TRUE Sharpe exceeds the best Sharpe expected from ``n_trials`` skill-less trials, given non-normal returns and the effective sample length. - ``bootstrap_sharpe_ci``: Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap CI (annualised), robust to the autocorrelation. |
| [survivorship.py](survivorship.py) | Survivorship-bias measurement (Blueprint §3.4). |
